title: epigynum parviflorum
intro: Epigynum parviflorum, commonly known as the "Yellow Bignay", is a tropical tree species native to Southeast Asia. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Epigynum parviflorum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
